subject: The flight deck of the colony ship ariadne at night, two officers on watch, stars in the big window. One of the quietest people on the ship and one of the loudest, on one watch. By the log, Jeremy has said eleven words in four hours and Hamond has said the rest. Between them on a spare console panel is a board scratched in with a nail, and they're playing a game with washers that nobody else understands. Only these two officers are seen clearly; the other four at the table or on the ship are faceless: backs turned, in shadow or cut off by the frame.

notes: A crew photo for one pairing of this card's two leads. The incident is NOT the plain soc scene with faces swapped: this version of the card was rewritten for these two people (title: The Quiet Shift). Read the version's text for what must be visible.
